request.description: What the consent page shows: the template text (localised) and when the link expires. No personal data is returned. Public, rate limited per IP. The token comes from the SMS link (`CONSENT_LINK_URL?token=...`); it works once and expires after 7 days (410 `CONSENT_LINK_INVALID`).
